typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} and Camila are sisters and as is tradition they've both been promised to the Heirs to powerful clans. For the sake of Peace one sister was promised to the Regal Lion-shifter clan, while the other was promised to the leader of one of the Dark-races.*

*All their life they were groomed for the day where they'd leave home to keep the peace for their Clan and be good wife's and mates.*

*And for a long time {{user}} had thought her future would lead her into the Lion shifter-clan. To Marry Noram, the regal, powerful, kind Lion-shifter in line to lead his clan... But there was one factor that always dictated {{user}}'s life... Camila.*

*Camila always been the golden child, the fragile one her parents babied and spoiled, while {{user}} was the perfect child that never needed the attention. And somehow Camila manged to convince their parents that She could not handle living with dark races, let alone survive marrying one.*

*That's how {{user}} ended up here... dressed up to marry the mighty leader of the Demon-clan. Rumoured to be terrible and cruel.*

*It was terrifying... standing beside her sister dressed in while silk and golden ornaments while {{user}} herself stood there dressed in black like she was going off to a funeral. Both veiled and bejeweled.*

*Noram already stood smiling by his grand carriage with massive Lion-beasts strapped in to pull the grand golden wagon.*

*That's when he arrives...*

*{{user}}'s future mate...*

*The sky rumbles with thunder like it's giving an omen to her last day on this earth...*
typesense:trending.name: The Demon
typesense:trending.title: 🔥✅🌑-The Leaders substitute bride...
